verses.text: Here are the laws and rulings you must carefully follow in the land Yahweh, the God of your ancestors, has given you to own. Keep them as long as you live on earth.
Destroy every place where the nations you’re taking the land from served their gods, on the high mountains, on the hills, and under every green tree.
Tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, and burn their Asherah poles. Cut down the carved images of their gods and wipe their names out of those places.
Don’t worship Yahweh your God that way.
Go to the place Yahweh your God chooses from among your tribes to put his name. Seek him where he makes his home and go there.
Bring your burnt offerings, sacrifices, tithes, wave offerings, offerings you’ve vowed to give, offerings you give freely, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.
Eat there before Yahweh your God. You and your households will celebrate everything you’ve worked at that Yahweh your God has blessed.
Don’t keep doing what we’re doing here today, with everyone deciding for themselves what’s right.
You haven’t yet reached the place of rest or the inheritance Yahweh your God is giving you.
But when you cross the Jordan and settle in the land Yahweh your God gives you as your inheritance, he’ll give you rest from all the enemies around you, and you’ll live in safety.

Then bring everything I tell you to the place Yahweh your God chooses for his name to dwell: your burnt offerings, sacrifices, tithes, wave offerings, and all the choice offerings you’ve vowed to give Yahweh.
Celebrate before Yahweh your God with your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levite in your town, because the Levite has no share or inheritance with you.
Be careful where you offer your burnt offerings. You can’t just bring them to any place you see.
Bring your burnt offerings to the place Yahweh chooses in one of your tribes. Do everything I’m commanding you there.

You can still slaughter animals and eat meat in any of your towns whenever you want, according to what Yahweh your God has given you. Both clean and unclean people can eat it, just as they can eat gazelle or deer.
Just don’t eat the blood. Pour it onto the ground like water.

You can’t eat these things in your own towns: the tithe of your grain, new wine, or oil, the firstborn of your herds or flocks, any offering you’ve vowed to give, anything you’re giving freely, or your wave offerings.

Eat them in front of Yahweh your God at the place he chooses. Bring your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levite in your town. Celebrate everything you’ve worked at before Yahweh your God.
Be careful to look after the Levites for as long as you live in your land.
When Yahweh your God expands your territory as he promised, and you say, “I feel like eating meat,” go ahead and eat as much meat as you want.
If the place Yahweh your God chooses for his name is too far away, slaughter animals from the herd or flock Yahweh has given you, as I’ve told you. Eat as much as you like in your own towns.
Eat it the way you’d eat gazelle or deer. Clean and unclean people can eat it alike.
Just make sure you don’t eat the blood, because the blood is the life. Don’t eat the life along with the meat.
Pour the blood onto the ground like water. Don’t eat it.
Keep from eating it so things will go well for you and your children after you. Do what’s right in Yahweh’s eyes.
Take the holy things you’ve set apart and the offerings you’ve vowed to give to the place Yahweh chooses.
Offer both the meat and the blood of your burnt offerings on Yahweh your God’s altar. For your other sacrifices, pour the blood on his altar and eat the meat.
Listen and carefully follow everything I’m telling you. Then things will go well for you and your children forever as you do what’s good and right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.
Yahweh your God will cut off the nations ahead of you when you go in to take their land, and you’ll take their land and live in it.

Once those nations have been destroyed ahead of you, watch out that you don’t get trapped into copying them. Don’t go asking about their gods, saying, “How did those nations serve their gods? I’ll do the same.”
Don’t worship Yahweh your God the way they worshiped their gods. They did every detestable thing Yahweh hates for their gods. They even burned their sons and daughters in the fire for them.
Be careful to do everything I command you. Don’t add anything to it or take anything away.
